package handler

import (
	"context"
	player "example.com/mmorpg-practice/game/entities/player"
	scene "example.com/mmorpg-practice/game/entities/scene"
	sender "example.com/mmorpg-practice/game/handler/syncsender"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/dataengine"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest"
	"sync"
	"testing"
)

type mmoGetter map[int64]entity.IThreadSafeEntity

func (g mmoGetter) Get(_ context.Context, id int64, _ entity.EntityCategory) (entity.IThreadSafeEntity, error) {
	if value := g[id]; value != nil {
		return value, nil
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown entity %d", id)
}
func (g mmoGetter) GetMany(ctx context.Context, ids []int64, cats []entity.EntityCategory) ([]entity.IThreadSafeEntity, error) {
	values := make([]entity.IThreadSafeEntity, len(ids))
	for i, id := range ids {
		value, err := g.Get(ctx, id, cats[i])
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		values[i] = value
	}
	return values, nil
}

// 正式 Nest 提交路径的替身；本场景不声称 WAL fsync / Mongo 验收，真实存储另跑标准生成工程脚本。
type mmoCommitter struct{}

func (mmoCommitter) Commit(context.Context, dataengine.CommitRecord) error { return nil }

type mmoFixture struct {
	engine  *nest.NestMgr
	players [2]*player.Player
	scenes  [2]*scene.Scene
}

func newMMOFixture(t *testing.T) *mmoFixture {
	t.Helper()
	player.RegisterEntity()
	scene.RegisterEntity()
	RegisterMmoTasksNestHandlers()
	f := &mmoFixture{}
	g := mmoGetter{}
	for i := range 2 {
		pid, _ := entity.BuildEntityID(int64(800+i), player.EntityKindPlayer)
		sid, _ := entity.BuildEntityID(int64(800+i), scene.EntityKindScene)
		p, err := entity.BuildEntity(&entity.EntityCreateParam{IsCreate: true, Id: pid, Kind: player.EntityKindPlayer})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		s, err := entity.BuildEntity(&entity.EntityCreateParam{IsCreate: true, Id: sid, Kind: scene.EntityKindScene})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		f.players[i] = p.(*player.Player)
		f.scenes[i] = s.(*scene.Scene)
		g[pid] = p
		g[sid] = s
	}
	f.engine = nest.NewEngine(nest.NestOptionWithGetter(g), nest.NestOptionWithTransactionCommitter(mmoCommitter{}), nest.NestOptionWithWorkerPools(nest.WorkerPoolConfig{Workers: 2, QueueCap: 32}, nest.WorkerPoolConfig{}, nest.WorkerPoolConfig{}))
	if err := f.engine.Start(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = f.engine.Shutdown(context.Background()) })
	init := nest.NewHandlerName("mmo_init_" + t.Name())
	nest.MustRegisterHandlerWithMeta(init, func(es []entity.IThreadSafeEntity, _ []any, _ ...nest.HandlerOption) (any, error) {
		p := es[0].(*player.Player)
		p.Dao().SetGold(50)
		p.Dao().SetSceneID(f.scenes[0].ID())
		return nil, nil
	}, nest.HandlerMeta{Rollback: nest.RollbackUndo, Durability: nest.DurabilityStrict})
	for _, p := range f.players {
		if _, err := f.engine.Request(context.Background(), init, p.ID(), nil); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	seed := nest.NewHandlerName("mmo_scene_" + t.Name())
	nest.MustRegisterHandlerWithMeta(seed, func(es []entity.IThreadSafeEntity, _ []any, _ ...nest.HandlerOption) (any, error) {
		es[0].(*scene.Scene).Dao().SetOccupants(2)
		return nil, nil
	}, nest.HandlerMeta{Rollback: nest.RollbackUndo, Durability: nest.DurabilityStrict})
	if _, err := f.engine.Request(context.Background(), seed, f.scenes[0].ID(), nil); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return f
}
func TestMMORPGPartyReplay(t *testing.T) {
	f := newMMOFixture(t)
	s := sender.NewMmoTasksSender(f.engine)
	ctx := context.Background()
	for range 2 {
		if err := s.MultiSync_MMORPGParty(ctx, f.players[0].ID(), f.players[1].ID(), 17); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if err := s.MultiSync_MMORPGParty(ctx, f.players[0].ID(), f.players[1].ID(), 18); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("conflicting party accepted")
	}
	for _, p := range f.players {
		if p.Dao().GetPartyID() != 17 {
			t.Fatal("party membership split")
		}
	}
}
func TestMMORPGTradeConcurrentReplay(t *testing.T) {
	f := newMMOFixture(t)
	s := sender.NewMmoTasksSender(f.engine)
	ctx := context.Background()
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	errs := make([]error, 8)
	for i := range errs {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func(i int) {
			defer wg.Done()
			errs[i] = s.MultiSync_MMORPGTrade(ctx, f.players[0].ID(), f.players[1].ID(), 1, 10, false)
		}(i)
	}
	wg.Wait()
	for _, err := range errs {
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if f.players[0].Dao().GetGold() != 40 || f.players[1].Dao().GetGold() != 60 {
		t.Fatal("replay duplicated transfer")
	}
	if err := s.MultiSync_MMORPGTrade(ctx, f.players[0].ID(), f.players[1].ID(), 1, 11, false); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("changed identity accepted")
	}
}
func TestMMORPGTradeRollback(t *testing.T) {
	f := newMMOFixture(t)
	s := sender.NewMmoTasksSender(f.engine)
	ctx := context.Background()
	if err := s.MultiSync_MMORPGTrade(ctx, f.players[0].ID(), f.players[1].ID(), 1, 10, true); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("rejection lost")
	}
	if f.players[0].Dao().GetGold() != 50 || f.players[1].Dao().GetGold() != 50 || f.players[0].Dao().GetTradeSeq() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("partial trade survived rollback")
	}
	if err := s.MultiSync_MMORPGTrade(ctx, f.players[0].ID(), f.players[1].ID(), 1, 10, false); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
func TestMMORPGTransferRollbackReplayAndStaleRequest(t *testing.T) {
	f := newMMOFixture(t)
	s := sender.NewMmoTasksSender(f.engine)
	ctx := context.Background()
	p := f.players[0]
	a, b := f.scenes[0], f.scenes[1]
	if err := s.MultiSync_MMORPGTransfer(ctx, p.ID(), a.ID(), b.ID(), 1, true); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("rejection lost")
	}
	if p.Dao().GetSceneID() != a.ID() || p.Dao().GetSceneVersion() != 0 || a.Dao().GetOccupants() != 2 || b.Dao().GetOccupants() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("partial scene transfer survived")
	}
	for range 2 {
		if err := s.MultiSync_MMORPGTransfer(ctx, p.ID(), a.ID(), b.ID(), 1, false); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if a.Dao().GetOccupants() != 1 || b.Dao().GetOccupants() != 1 {
		t.Fatal("replay changed population")
	}
	if err := s.MultiSync_MMORPGTransfer(ctx, p.ID(), b.ID(), a.ID(), 2, false); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := s.MultiSync_MMORPGTransfer(ctx, p.ID(), a.ID(), b.ID(), 1, false); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("stale scene transfer accepted")
	}
	if p.Dao().GetSceneID() != a.ID() || a.Dao().GetOccupants() != 2 || b.Dao().GetOccupants() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("scene membership disagrees")
	}
}
